blocks.text: MRS. F.R. MCLAUGHLIN

Died At Her Home In Lincoln Township.
Loved And Respected
By All Who Knew Her.

Miss Cora Evans was born in Knox
County, Illinois and was married to
Mr. F. R. McLaughlin in 1885. Soon
after their marriage they collected
their belongings together and started
west and located on their present
farm. They rented this farm tor four
years of L. C. Whipple when they finally
bought it. By judicious-management
they have brought this farm
up to the very highest state of cultivation
and have raised their family of
three sons and four daughters. Here,
when this country was new and household
duties were numerous Mrs. McLaughlin
could often be seen going or
coming from tbe sick bed of a neighbor
where she bad been spreading
golden grains of oomfort and cheer to
tbe afflicted. Her sweet Christian
life was ppent for others. Although
frail of body her strength never failed
her while in tbe work of her Master.
Day or night she was ready to promote
His work and to do His bidding.
